about.html:
Company Profile

A Digital Life Management Platform for a Smarter, Connected Bangladesh

Life OS is a product of Neolife Global (Pvt.) Ltd., a Bangladesh company specialised in sales & marketing, business development and digital solutions. Life OS brings all essential services together in one secure platform — one Life ID, one app and 26 essential services — to simplify life, save time, reduce costs and create more opportunities for everyone.

At Life OS, we believe technology should simplify life. One Life ID. One App. Unlimited Services!

Our platform connects people with the services they need — banking, payments, healthcare, education, travel, shopping, government services and much more — through a single trusted digital identity.

Life OS delivers this experience through its four pillars:

Life ID. One secure digital identity for all your services and verification — your key to the whole ecosystem.

One App. 26 essential services in one easy-to-use app, available anytime, anywhere. Explore our services.

Security. Advanced protection keeps your data and money safe, so every transaction is secure and reliable.

People. Life OS is built for every individual, family and business in Bangladesh — empowering millions of lives and creating a better tomorrow.

 

Our Vision

  • A smarter and connected Bangladesh.
  • One platform where every citizen can reach essential services with one Life ID.
 

Our Mission

To empower the lives and well-being of our members, partners, customers, and staff with the highest quality, scientifically proven & clinically researched products, innovative and best business opportunities.
 

Our Promise

  • Simplify lives through one secure platform with 26 essential services.
  • Empower every individual and business with trusted digital services.
  • Deliver excellence, security and value in everything we do.
  • Keep innovating to make life easier, more connected and more meaningful.

Meet Our Life OS Team

At Life OS, our team plays a pivotal role in driving the innovation, quality and reliability of the platform. We bring together engineers, service designers and business builders who share one goal — make essential services simple for everyone in Bangladesh.

Our team stays at the forefront of the latest advancements in digital technology, continually improving the platform so your Life ID, payments, healthcare, education and everyday services always work smoothly and securely.

We also believe that empowering our users with knowledge is essential. That is why our team regularly shares guides, tips and training on how to get the most out of the 26 essential services inside Life OS.

At the core of Life OS is a promise: every service we deliver is backed by technology, crafted with care and dedicated to improving the quality of life for our users and communities.

Tanvir Rahman
MSc in CSE (BUET)

Specialization: Digital platforms & system architecture

Tanvir leads the engineering of the Life OS platform. He built the core Life ID system that lets one secure identity power 26 essential services — from banking and payments to healthcare and shopping — for millions of users across Bangladesh.

Nusrat Jahan
MBA (University of Dhaka)

Specialization: Service delivery & partnerships

Nusrat heads service delivery at Life OS. She works with partner banks, hospitals, telcos and government services to make sure every service inside Life OS is reliable, affordable and easy to use, and that partners meet our quality and security standards.

Arif Chowdhury
PhD in Computer Science (BUET)

PhD (Universiti Malaya)

Business Opportunity

Build Meaningful Opportunities with Life OS

READY TO HELP BUILD A MORE CONNECTED BANGLADESH?

Life OS welcomes verified service providers, merchants, community organisers and business partners who share our commitment to useful, secure and accessible digital services.

  • Your own business
  • Be your own boss
  • Control your own time
  • Your own dreams & goals
  • No salary cap
  • Less risk and no overhead costs
  • Unlimited potential for wealth
  • Be recognized for your actions
  • Enjoy residual income
  • Helping others to make a positive difference in their lives
  • You earn what you’re worth
  • Help people live healthier – physically & financially
  • Spend more time with family and friends
  • Work from home or café… wherever!

Choose the pathway that fits your work: become a verified merchant, connect a specialised service, support customer onboarding, or help communities learn to use Life OS confidently.

Every collaboration begins with verification, service-quality review and clear operating standards. Availability, commercial terms and responsibilities are confirmed in a written partner agreement.

 

How Do I Start?

Begin by registering your interest. Our partnership team will review your profile, discuss the right model, and guide approved applicants through verification, training and launch preparation.

 

How Can I Grow?

Growth comes from delivering dependable service and earning customer trust. Approved partners may receive service tools, training, campaign support and performance guidance under their agreement.

Terms, eligibility and any commercial benefits vary by partnership type and are confirmed before activation.

Content

FAQ - General

What is Life OS?

  1. 1)Q: Where can I login?
    A: For login, kindly copy the link and paste at the URL. http://www.lifeosbd.com
  2. 2)Q: How to change or reset the password?
    A: Please proceed to member login “Personal Details” > “Edit Profile” > “Change Password” option.
    Or you may click the “Forgot Password” option for reset. Company notify new password via email/sms as per system info.

    Once you have received the temporary password, kindly reset your password IMMEDIATELY with the temporary password in Change Login Password and Change Maker Password option.
    Kindly login immediately to set your new password because this password is valid for 24 hours only.

    How do I get my Life ID?

    A: Your Life ID is created when you register on the Life OS app or through a Life OS Business Center. It becomes your single secure identity for all services on the platform.

  3. 3)I received a new temporary password? What do I need to do next?
    A: A: To change the password, kindly proceed to member login > “Personal Details” > “Change Password” option Kindly change your password in Change Login Password and Change Maker Password option.
  4. 4) Q: I cannot login into my account, it mentioned please submit your id. How can I proceed from here?
    A: Please email your complete details and attached copy of Identity Card to info@lifeosbd.com
  5. 5) Q: How do I change my email address and contact number?
    A: You may proceed to member log-in > “Personal Details” > “Edit Profile” option or email to info@lifeosbd.com with below details:
    1. Username
    2. Name
    3. Copy of Identity card
    4. Contact number old and new
    5. Email address old and new

    p/s: Please provide all your details as registered in the system, if you have made a mistake or forgot we will not be able to verify your password

  6. 6) Q: I want to change my country code because I no longer working/reside in that country.
    A: For your information, we will not accept the request for change of country code EXCEPT the following:
    1. Account holder’s citizenship is from the country of origin.
    2. Migrated
    3. Long term working in that country with a valid working permit.
    4. No country stockist in your current country.

    If any of the conditions above is satisfied, we then proceed to change the country code to the country requested. However if member wish to revert back to their initial country code there will be charges involved.

    The service can only be collected from country requested as registered in the system only.

    p/s: Request of change of country code is strictly for one-time only without charges..

  7. 7) Q: If I am unable to collect (self-collect) my service due to time constraint. Can I ask my upline/representative to collect on my behalf?

    A: YES, but your representative (upline or direct sponsor) must produce an authorization letter, order number (voucher) and ID card for verification purposes.

    For your information, all service collection is only valid for 6 months from the date of purchase.

  8. 8) Q: If I wrongly transfer the PSP to wrong account/wrong maker. What action can I do to rectify?

    A: Please provide the screenshot of the transaction and email details to info@lifeosbd.com for further assistance.

  9. 9) Q: If I’m really interested to join your company, how can I proceed to join?

    A: You may click the “Join Us” option at the right corner of the page and fill in the correct details. Our team will assist you further. The link of our website is http://www.lifeosbd.com

  10. 10) Q: If I wish to terminate my account and withdraw all my PSP, how can I do?
    A: If you wish to terminate or cancel the account, kindly provide us:

    1) An Official letter with the account holder’s signature and the reason for termination
    2) Username
    3) A copy of identity card
    4) Contact number
    5) Email address

    Kindly make sure that all your Maker's balance have been emptied or transferred before the termination. Once the account has been terminate, the point cannot be retrieved.

    p/s: All requests are subjected to approval by Management. All request must accompanied with complete documents.
    p/s: All terminated accounts will not be allowed to re-register within 6 months from the date of termination.

  11. 11) Q: If I want to transfer my account to my family/friends, is this permissible?

    A: YES you can. If you wish to transfer the account, the following documents are required:

    1. Identity card copy from both parties (transferor and transferee)
    2. Letter of Commissioner for Oaths / Affidavit
    3. Letter to The Management to indicate the reason of transfer
    4. Contact number and email address from both parties.
    5. Fill in partners request and complaint form

    *Fees applicable for transfer of ownership will be deducted from the D-maker (PSP 33.33)
    *All requests for transfer must accompanied with complete documents and the approval is subjected to Management’s approval.

  12. 12) Q: If I am a member and I want to apply to be a country stockist, how can I apply for it?

    A: Kindly email to info@lifeosbd.com , we will refer you to relevant department for further assistance.

  13. 13) Q: If I wrongly placed/sponsored a new member under different username, how can I rectify this?

    A: For your information, once the placement or sponsor registration has been submitted, NO changes is allowed.

  14. 14) Q: If My upline wrongly key-in my ID card number and my name, How can I make correction for it?

    A: For your information, all correction is strictly allow for typo error only. Please email to info@lifeosbd.com and provide a username and a copy of identity card for further process.

  15. 15) Q: If I’m not at home when courier service came to my house, how can I collect it?

    A: Please contact the courier company for collection. Failing which please provide us the order number and tracking number for us to assist you. We will check further and will SMS member as per contact number registered in the system.

  16. 16) Q: If I want to make a complaint about my upline or any member. How and where can I complaint?
    A: Please provide complete information in order for us to make further investigations.
    1. Name of complainer
    2. A copy of the identity card (clear and cross the copy) of complainer
    3. The date and procedure of registration
